content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definition_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by Disclosing Party that is marked as confidential or that should reasonably be regarded as confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligation_of_Receiving_Party
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purposes set forth in this agreement and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Term_and_Termination
content_blocks.text: This agreement shall remain in effect until terminated by either party with thirty (30) days written notice.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 22nd day of June 2024.
